* Fixed assumptions for the example monthly cost: 100 calls/day · 2,000 input / 800 output tokens per call · off-peak rates · 30% cache hit rate · 30-day month — the same formula and defaults as the cost calculator. USD models are converted to CNY at the reference rate for comparison (see summary). Costs within display precision are marked tied; neither side is favored.

Comparison summary (fixed usage basis)

  • Estimated monthly cost: Hunyuan TurboS Vision ¥39.60 vs Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro ¥92.40 on a common CNY basis (list prices ¥39.60 / ¥92.40) — at this fixed usage, Hunyuan TurboS Vision is cheaper by ¥52.8/month.
  • Cost ratio: under this basis, Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro costs about 2.3× Hunyuan TurboS Vision (Hunyuan TurboS Vision is ~57% cheaper). The ratio holds only at the current list prices, reference rate and fixed usage assumptions; it says nothing about capability, output quality or overall value.
  • Input unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices ¥3 vs ¥7; after conversion Hunyuan TurboS Vision is lower (by ≈ ¥4/1M tokens).
  • Output unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices ¥9 vs ¥21; after conversion Hunyuan TurboS Vision is lower (by ≈ ¥12/1M tokens).
  • Cache-hit price (off-peak basis): Hunyuan TurboS Vision publishes no cache price (estimated at the standard input price); Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro publishes no cache price (estimated at the standard input price).
  • Context window: Hunyuan TurboS Vision 128K vs Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro 1000K — Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro is 7.8× Hunyuan TurboS Vision.
  • Modalities: Hunyuan TurboS Vision=Text, Image understanding; Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro=Text (Hunyuan TurboS Vision adds Image understanding).
  • Price sources: Tencent Cloud Hunyuan billing (verified 2026-09-18), Alibaba Cloud Model Studio pricing (verified 2026-09-18); unit: official list price per 1M tokens (Hunyuan TurboS Vision in CNY, Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro in CNY).

These are computations from published list prices under fixed call volume, token usage, cache assumptions and billing rules. They are not rankings of capability, output quality or overall value, and do not constitute purchase advice.
